prompts.label: 1 — Closest to the original
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Primary request: repair the duplicated Digital Crown in the edit target, changing the smallest possible region. Input image 1 is the edit target: the selected Endless Crown editorial wrist photograph with counter 4698. Input image 2 is ONLY a hardware geometry reference: the official Apple Watch frame shows a single Digital Crown, not two stacked knobs. Do not paste the reference frame or change the Watch model. Maintain a photorealistic natural editorial photograph with the same adult wrist, gray knit sleeve, dark band, soft neutral window light, skin texture, blurred background and wide framing. Keep the entire Watch display unchanged and fitted to the same screen perspective: rows 4695, 4696, 4697, highlighted 4698, 4699, 4700, the Clicks chip and hand icon, time 3:26. Preserve the exact headline and its typography/placement: 'Endless Crown', 'Turn the Crown.', 'Feel the haptics.'. Keep the case, bezel, screen, strap, forearm, sleeve, background and composition unchanged. Only edit the Crown hardware and the fingertip contact area specified below. Avoid extra knobs, stacked toothed wheels, a second concentric raised knurled cylinder, exaggerated axle, duplicate buttons, melted metal, strange hands, extra fingers, finger-device intersections, new text, watermark, UI redraws, recoloring or composition drift. One opaque wide image, approximately the original 21:9 composition, at the highest available resolution. Crown correction: at the Watch's right edge the target currently has a large toothed wheel against the case AND a second smaller toothed cylinder protruding under the index finger. Replace that whole malformed two-stage assembly with ONE short silver Digital Crown, one continuous knurled rim and a flat circular outer face, mounted on one short plain attachment to the Watch case. The official reference is the shape guide. There must be exactly ONE ridged wheel. Keep the original pinch pose and move only the few contacting fingertip pixels as necessary so index finger and thumb touch that same single Crown. The resulting hardware must look like a real flush-mounted Apple Watch Crown with natural scale, lighting, contact and shadow. Everything outside this small hardware/contact region must remain unchanged.

prompts.label: 4 — Crown fully visible
prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: App Store header design alternative for Endless Crown.
Input images: Image 1 is a reference for the natural lifestyle photo, typography and app display content; it contains INCORRECT hardware and must NOT be copied as the Watch hardware. Image 2 is the reference for the actual Watch case and ONE shallow Digital Crown.
Primary request: Create a new, realistic photograph alternative with a different right-hand pose that avoids the reference's stacked two-Crown artifact. Preserve the neutral daylight editorial look, gray knit sleeve, adult left wrist wearing a dark sport band, softly blurred home background, and wide layout with headline on the left. Recreate the Watch as a normal silver Apple Watch with ONE compact knurled Digital Crown immediately next to the right case edge, one flat outward face, and no concentric smaller protruding cylinder. The Crown is thin and shallow like image 2, not a large gear or a stepped axle. Hardware realism is the priority.
Watch display: coherent perspective directly on its glass surface. The same simple black UI with gray rounded number rows: 4695, 4696, 4697, selected 4698 in white, 4699, 4700. Small clock "3:26" top right. Rounded "Clicks" control with a small white outlined finger icon near the lower rows. Preserve all numbers exactly and consecutively. Avoid skewed overlays and floating screens.
Text (verbatim): "Endless Crown" above two large lines "Turn the Crown." and "Feel the haptics." on the left, simple white/off-white sans-serif, clear contrast, same quiet composition.
Constraints: believable fingers and nails, true photographic skin and textile texture, restrained color and neutral daylight, wide 21:9 framing, opaque background, no extra copy, no orange cinematic grading, no CGI gloss.
Avoid: double Crown, second stacked disk, protruding outer axle, two parallel knurled cylinders, extra fingers, fused fingers, screen drift, changed numbers, device bezel pasted over a photo.
Pose and angle: The Watch face is more frontal, with only a slight wrist tilt. The opposite hand approaches from upper right with index finger hovering about 1 cm above the Crown, thumb away from the case. Show the entire single shallow Crown clearly with NO fingertip overlapping it. A relaxed moment just before turning the Crown. Do not reproduce the old pinching gesture.
